title: Uploaded image deletion behavior decision
purpose: Document the unresolved requests for what happens when an image owner selects Delete, along with proposed stories and acceptance criteria for each alternative pending a human decision.

scope.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

requirements.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete.

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate permanent deletion policy, an image owner can select Delete on an uploaded image and have that image be permanently deleted immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when an image owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the uploaded image is permanently deleted immediately afterward.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day recoverability policy, an image owner can select Delete on an uploaded image and still recover that image for 30 days after Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverability policy, when an image owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the image remains recoverable by that owner for 30 days after Delete.

Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverability policy, when 30 days have passed since the image owner selected Delete on an uploaded image, then the image is no longer recoverable by that owner.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.

risks.text: Selecting the immediate permanent deletion policy would fail the request that a deleted image remain recoverable for 30 days; selecting the 30-day recoverability policy would fail the request for immediate permanent deletion.

open_questions: Which deletion behavior should a human select: immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete, or recoverability by its owner for 30 days after Delete?
Who has authority to choose between the privacy stakeholder's request and the support stakeholder's request?
